Range & Retracement · Intermediate

Optimal Trade Entry (OTE)

The PDF describes a retracement band around 62%–79% of an impulsive leg, with 70.5% as a midpoint convention.

Open interactive ICT Academy →Official ICT channel ↗Official playlists ↗

How to identify and use this concept

  1. Select clear impulsive leg.
  2. Draw retracement correctly.
  3. Mark 0.62, 0.705 and 0.79.
  4. Require FVG/OB and session/context filter.
Retracement framework after displacement.

Common mistakes and limitations

Do not draw fibs on choppy legs; OTE is not a stand-alone signal.
